name: novalume
description: Narrative-intelligent fiction discovery and reader platform — rights-gated launch foundation

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.build: python3 scripts/build_catalog.py && python3 scripts/build_story_index.py && python3 scripts/dynamic_narrative.py && python3 scripts/build_fts.py && python3 scripts/assemble_site.py
scripts.test: node --test src/*.test.js server/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py' && python3 scripts/check_no_paid_ai.py
